cohort: The study included normal pregnancies (n=18), pregnancies complicated with early-onset PE (n=9), and late-onset PE (n=9) from whom placental bed tissues were obtained during cesarean section deliveries.
finding: The mRNA and protein expression of leptin in the placental bed was significantly increased in the PE groups compared with normal controls and was associated with the onset period of PE.
cross-section timing: At the time of cesarean section delivery
